## IE2eUpdateOptions type

Base update options for E2E updates.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IE2eUpdateOptions = {
    user?: IE2eUser;
    chat?: IE2eChat;
    date?: number;
    message_id?: number;
};
```
**References:** [IE2eUser](./gramstax.ie2euser.md)<!-- -->, [IE2eChat](./gramstax.ie2echat.md)

## Remarks

Shared envelope for every `E2eHelper.send*` simulation method. Controls the sender, chat, and sequencing (`message_id`<!-- -->, `date`<!-- -->) of the injected update.
